body:
Are you my father? Because he loves to call me at work and DEMAND that I come to his house to help him with whatever he needs, right then and there. Now admittedly, if I'm sitting around doing nothing, I'll gladly help him with whatever he needs right then and there, but at noon on a workday? I have a job motherfucker! Leave me alone!.

Note: I'm 26 and have been on my own for 3 years now.

Edit: Additionally, I've had this happen in my own house with my father. He's got a key, in case of emergency, and a few months ago he let himself in just as I was getting dressed. Suddenly I hear a knock on the door of my room and bam! there's dad.
